verification.validation: Basic release gate (bash scripts/basic-gate.sh) run as root: docs, policy, version, protocol/admission limit and executor manifest checks, internal-content repo scan, Go vet/build (SDK and executor) and units (api, dsm, filestation, jsonlimits, identity), Node typecheck/build, frontend gate (typecheck, 1427 units, build, packed consumer import, pack contents), package content scans. The Node and Python run tests that refuse to run as root fail as root and pass as a non-root account (Node 34/34, Python all). The idgateway ingress inventory tests for #220 pass; its process-lifetime suites belong to the integration gate. Both npm tarballs scanned for internal content before publication. No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: The identity gateway's ingress ownership check reads a stopped package's short-path redirects (etc/short-paths-nginx.conf) for other packages and for the package's own upgrade (from #220).

bootEntryPage retries app.status failures that are not refusals after 250/500/1000/2000 ms (ENTRY_STATUS_RETRY_DELAYS_MS) and hands off to an active portal alias's sign-in before DSM's App start (from #221).

The entry page keeps its address (rewriteToAlias: true restores the alias rewrite); ctx.entryURL is the shareable link; the page URL option is renamed pageURL; browser hosts open DSM launch links outside the desktop; portal.mountPanel works on entry pages; link/intake survive DSM's sign-in; ctx.uiUpdate reads entry.json first (from #222).

With daemonIngress, the entry's app.status at boot and in the background check goes to the App's daemon ingress instead of a CGI process; a daemon that did not answer falls back to the CGI (from #223).
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
